vachanas.kannada:
ತನು ಬತ್ತಲೆಯಾದಡೇನು, ಮನ ಬತ್ತಲೆಯಾಗದನ್ನಕ್ಕ ?
ವ್ರತವಿದ್ದಡೇನು, ವ್ರತಹಿನರಾದ ಬಳಿಕ ?
ನೆರೆದಡೆ ನರಕವಯ್ಯಾ ನಿಂಬೇಶ್ವರಾ.
vachanas.transliteration:
tanu battaleyādaḍēnu, mana battaleyāgadannakka ?
vrataviddaḍēnu, vratahinarāda baḷika ?
neredaḍe narakavayyā nimbēśvarā.
vachanas.translation:
What is the use if the body is left naked,
When the mind has not become naked of its attachments?
What is the use of observing vows,
Once those vows have been abandoned?
The end of such a path is surely hell,
O Nimbēśvara.
